headline.purpose: Page titles — one per route. Always the largest text on screen.

title.purpose: Section headers within a page. Max two per screen.

body.purpose: Descriptive text, secondary table values, activity feeds.

label.purpose: Column headers, badge text, KPI card labels. Max 4 words, always uppercase.

tabular.purpose: All numeric values — IDs, dates, prices, counters. Monospaced digits prevent column drift.

shadows.name: primary-cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Applied only to primary buttons (bg-admin-primary). Amethyst bloom that signals the primary action. Lifts on hover.

shadows.name: surface-lift
shadows.purpose: shadow-sm on secondary buttons and filter tab containers. Near-invisible confirmation of interactivity.

motion.name: sidebar-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile sidebar slide in/out. Ease-out-standard. Never bouncy.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for hover/focus state changes on buttons and interactive surfaces.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Page-level entrance animation (animate-fade-in). Slides in from -10px translateY.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The primary call-to-action. Most visually dominant interactive element on any given screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #A855F7; color: #ffffff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #9333EA; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px -2px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A855F7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary actions. Quiet at rest, clear on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #ffffff; color: #555555; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #E5E2DE; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #F6F3F0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A855F7; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Stat Card
components.description: Metric summary card with corner-arc status tint. Never use side-stripe borders.
components.html:
TOTAL PENDING

Butuh verifikasi segera
components.css: .ds-kpi-card { position: relative; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #E5E2DE; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; min-width: 200px; } .ds-kpi-arc { position: absolute; right: -16px; top: -16px; width: 96px; height: 96px; border-radius: 0 0 0 9999px; background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); pointer-events: none; } .ds-kpi-label { display: block; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; color: #555555; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 700; color: #d97706; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-kpi-desc { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #555555; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Item (Active)
components.description: Active nav state. Solid Administrative Amethyst fill — must read at a glance for ops users scanning fast.
components.html: Listing Approval5User Management
components.css: .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-inactive { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-active { background: #A855F7; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(168,85,247,0.2); } .ds-nav-inactive { color: #555555; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; } .ds-nav-inactive:hover { background: #F6F3F0; color: #111111; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-badge-active { margin-left: auto; background: #ffffff; color: #A855F7; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; }

components.name: Status Badge (Pending)
components.description: Inline status indicator. Always rounded-full. Dot pulses on Pending only.
components.css: .ds-badge-pending, .ds-badge-approved, .ds-badge-rejected { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #fffbeb; color: #d97706; } .ds-badge-approved { background: #f0fdf4; color: #059669; } .ds-badge-rejected { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; } .ds-badge-dot, .ds-badge-dot-green, .ds-badge-dot-red { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-badge-dot { background: #f59e0b; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } .ds-badge-dot-green { background: #10B981; } .ds-badge-dot-red { background: #ef4444; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.4} }

components.name: Filter Tabs
components.description: Segmented filter control. Active tab floats on surface white. Used on data tables.
components.css: .ds-filter-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; background: #F6F3F0; padding: 6px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-filter-tab { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #555555; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-filter-tab:hover { color: #111111; } .ds-filter-active { background: #ffffff; color: #A855F7; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); }

components.name: Toast Notification
components.description: Auto-dismiss 4s. Fixed bottom-right, above the status footer. Dot color signals type.
components.html: "Kulit Sekam Padi" disetujui dan dipublikasikan ke pasar.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; max-width: 20rem; pointer-events: auto; } .ds-toast-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-toast-success .ds-toast-dot { background: #34d399; } .ds-toast-error .ds-toast-dot { background: #f87171; } .ds-toast-info .ds-toast-dot { background: #60a5fa; } .ds-toast-msg { line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview:
This system governs a physical supply chain: agricultural waste moving from farms through intermediaries, logistics partners, and buyers. The admin panel is the dispatch terminal where the ops team manages this flow under load. Every screen answers one question: what needs action? Structure, reliability, and a slight industrial quality are features, not compromises.

The palette is controlled and non-decorative. Administrative Amethyst (#A855F7) is the authority signal that marks admin mode — distinct from the green seller-facing brand. Warm Slate (#F6F3F0) is the ambient field: warmer than a cold white canvas, suggesting a paper-based record system digitized into a terminal.

This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS admin aesthetic (Vercel/Linear clone): no dark sidebars with gradient icon backgrounds, no glassmorphism panels, no purple-to-violet gradient text.
keyCharacteristics: Single authority accent (Administrative Amethyst) on ≤15% of any screen
Warm Slate ambient field — grounded and tactile, not stark
Flat-by-default elevation — only primary CTAs lift
Semaphore status system (green / amber / red) used as language, never decoration
Tabular-nums on every data value: dates, prices, IDs, counters
WCAG 2.1 AA minimum on all text, without exception

rules.name: The Authority Rarity Rule
rules.body: Administrative Amethyst appears on ≤15% of any given screen. One active nav item. One primary button. One pagination indicator. The purple is a signal because it is rare.

rules.name: The No-Green Chrome Rule
rules.body: Semaphore Green (#10B981) is reserved for status indicators and the seller-facing brand. It never appears in admin chrome: buttons, nav, headers, card accents. A green button in the admin UI is a brand identity failure.

rules.name: The Semaphore Trio Rule
rules.body: Green / amber / red are a system. They are status language, not aesthetic choices. Never use one semaphore color decoratively while ignoring the others.

rules.name: The Tabular Absolute
rules.body: Every numeric data value — prices, IDs, dates, percentages, counters — uses font-tabular. No exceptions. Proportional digits in a data table are a readability and alignment failure.

rules.name: The Label Cap
rules.body: Uppercase tracking is reserved for column headers, badge text, and the status footer. All other text is title-case. All-caps sentences are prohibited.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards rest flat against Warm Slate. Shadow at rest means the surface hierarchy is broken. If a card needs to stand out, the answer is tonal contrast (Surface White on Warm Slate), not a lifted shadow.

dos: Do use Administrative Amethyst (#A855F7) exclusively as the admin authority signal. It is never decorative.
Do apply font-tabular to every numeric value: prices, IDs, dates, percentages, and counters.
Do use the semaphore trio as a system: green = approved/healthy, amber = pending/warning, red = rejected/error.
Do maintain WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast on all text. Field Muted (#555555) on Surface White passes 5.1:1.
Do keep the sidebar's active state as a solid Amethyst fill. A tint is too quiet for ops users scanning at speed.
Do write button labels as verb + object: Setujui Listing, Unduh Laporan, Tambah Pengguna Baru.
Do use rounded-2xl (16px) for cards and rounded-xl (12px) for interactive controls.
donts: Don't clone the generic SaaS admin aesthetic (Vercel, Linear). No gradient icon backgrounds, no glassmorphism cards.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe. Use background tints or corner-arc decoration instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient fill). All text uses one solid color.
Don't use green (#10B981) in admin chrome: buttons, nav highlights, header accents.
Don't nest cards. A surface inside a surface breaks the tonal hierarchy.
Don't display all-uppercase sentences. Uppercase is for labels (4 words max) only.
Don't use arbitrary z-index values. Semantic scale: content (auto) → topbar (z-20) → overlay (z-[25]) → sidebar (z-30) → toast (z-[100]).
Don't add shadow to resting cards. Elevation is earned by interaction, not applied to ambient surfaces.
